pages.text: At x=2, the floor shows the number of every line that has blocks. Its color tells you how the line is doing:
$(li)faint: a NOOP or COMMENT line$(li)dark green: the line is correct$(li)dark yellow: correct so far, but the statement is not finished yet$(li)dark red: something is wrong
Dark yellow is normal while you build. A BEGIN without its END shows dark yellow until you place the END. The debugging tool tells you what is wrong with a red line.
